lines.japanese: 次に目覚めたときは、きのうと同じ洗面所にいた。
lines.english: The next time I woke, I was in the same restroom as yesterday.

lines.japanese: 一瞬で現実に引きずりだされる≪スクランブル≫とは違った、ゆっくりと世界の一部に同調してゆく感覚。
lines.english: This was nothing like a *Scramble*, dragging me into reality all at once. Consciousness was slowly synchronizing with one small part of the world.

lines.japanese: 十本の指が、よし、動く。
lines.english: Ten fingers. Good. All moving.

lines.japanese: しかし時刻を確認した俺は──
lines.english: Then I checked the time—

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: ──慌てて着替えてトイレを飛びだすことになった。
lines.english: —and had to fling on my clothes and bolt from the restroom.

lines.japanese: いいかげん見慣れてきた洋食屋の前、俺は歩道に靴の先を突きたて、ぐるぐるぐると足首を高速で回した。同時に首と肩もほぐしながら、最後に軽くアキレス腱を伸ばす。
lines.english: Outside the Western-style restaurant that was finally becoming familiar, I dug one toe into the pavement and rolled my ankle rapidly around and around. At the same time I loosened my neck and shoulders, then finished with a quick stretch of each Achilles tendon.

lines.japanese: くそ、いまごろきっと、あの小娘がブーたれて待ってる。
lines.english: Shit. By now that little girl would be waiting—and sulking.

lines.japanese: Ｒ－ウィングの掲示板とやらを見に行く約束。集合場所はヤナボリ広場。待ち合わせ時刻は２２時３０分。
lines.english: We had promised to look at R-Wing's message board. Meeting place: Yanapoli Plaza. Meeting time: 22:30.

lines.japanese: そして現在の時刻が──２２時３５分！
lines.english: Current time—22:35!

lines.japanese: あのヤロウ、ゆうべに続いてまたしても延長かましやがった……。
lines.english: That bastard had gone overtime again, two nights running...

lines.japanese: しかも、何を入れたんだかスポーツバッグがやけに重い。さっきは大した相手でもないのに≪スクランブル≫かけやがるし。ふざけるな。あの野郎、やりたい放題じゃねえか。
lines.english: Worse, the sports bag was weirdly heavy with God knew what. Earlier he'd called a *Scramble* over some nobody, too. Fuck this. That bastard did whatever the hell he liked.

lines.japanese: 俺は鷲介への恨みを推進力に、花水木通りを中速で駆けだした。
lines.english: Fueled by resentment toward Shusuke, I set off down Flowering Dogwood Street at a steady run.

lines.japanese: そういや、俺が女のために走るなんて、たぶん初めてのことだ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, this was probably the first time I'd ever run for a woman.

lines.japanese: クソだせえ。
lines.english: Fucking pathetic.

lines.japanese: 「隼人くーん！」
lines.english: “Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 女の声で名前を呼ばれた。よせばいいのに、俺は思わず反射的に止まってしまった。
lines.english: A woman's voice called my name. I should've kept going, but I stopped on reflex.

lines.japanese: 「えー、なになにー？　どしたの、そんな急いじゃってー」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, what's all this? Why the hurry?”

lines.japanese: 香田か……。
lines.english: Koda...

lines.japanese: 俺は体の向きを進行方向から変えず、首だけ曲げて答えた。
lines.english: Keeping my body pointed where I was going, I twisted only my neck to answer.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっとな」
lines.english: “Something came up.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとって何……ええっ！　ちょっとちょっと！」
lines.english: “What do you mean, something...? Hey! Wait, wait!”

lines.japanese: 片腕を上げてそのまま走りだそうとしたら、やつが馴れ馴れしくその手を掴んで追いすがってきた。
lines.english: I raised one arm and tried to run on. With her usual total lack of boundaries, she caught my hand and came hurrying after me.

lines.japanese: 「なんでなんでー！　もう行っちゃうのー！？」
lines.english: “Why? Why? You're leaving already?”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 俺はいつものように、やつの手を振りほどいた──と、ふと目の端を違和感が通りすぎていった。
lines.english: As usual, I shook her off—and then something snagged at the edge of my vision.

lines.japanese: 「あれ」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「やっ……なに？」
lines.english: “Ah... what?”

lines.japanese: 香田の手首を拾いあげた。やつは女みたいな声をあげた。俺はその指先を確かめる。
lines.english: I caught Koda by the wrist again. She let out an absurdly feminine yelp. I examined her fingertips.

lines.japanese: 「あれ。おまえ、爪の落書き消したの」
lines.english: “Huh. You erased the doodles on your nails?”

lines.japanese: 「落書きじゃなーい！」
lines.english: “They weren't doodles!”

lines.japanese: やつは俺に腕を預けたままコンクリートを蹴って、俺の胸板に他愛もない頭突きを打ちこんだ。
lines.english: With her arm still in my grip, she sprang off the pavement and gave my chest a harmless little headbutt.

lines.japanese: その拍子に握っていた手を放すと、やつは生まれたままの指先を意味もなく擦りながら呟いた。
lines.english: The impact made me let go. Rubbing her bare fingertips together for no reason, she muttered:

lines.japanese: 「消したってゆーか、元々チップだし」
lines.english: “I didn't erase them. They were tips to begin with.”

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ」
lines.english: “What are those?”

lines.japanese: 「だから、付け爪？」
lines.english: “Fake nails?”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: あのヘンな雪の絵が入った爪、気に入ってるって自分できのう言ってたばっかなのに。随分と移り気の早い女だ。
lines.english: She'd told me only yesterday that she loved those nails with the weird snow scenes on them. Flighty as hell.

lines.japanese: 「てへへ」
lines.english: “Heh heh.”

lines.japanese: しかも、俺の顔と自分の手とを交互に見比べてにやついてる。薄気味悪いやつだ。
lines.english: Now she was grinning and looking back and forth between my face and her hands. Creepy.

lines.japanese: 「惚れたか。うり」
lines.english: “Fallen for me? Boop.”

lines.japanese: 十本の指を俺の服に立てる。もはや意味が分からない。
lines.english: She planted all ten fingertips against my clothes. I had no idea what any of this meant anymore.

lines.japanese: 「そんなことよりおまえ、森里は」
lines.english: “More importantly, where's Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつのツレを探して辺りを見回した。
lines.english: I looked around for her companion.

lines.japanese: ──いない。ひょっとして本気で受験勉強でも始めたんだろうか。どうでもいい。超どうでもいい。でもちょっとがんばれ。
lines.english: —Nowhere. Maybe he'd actually started studying for his entrance exams. None of my business. Profoundly none. Still—good luck.

lines.japanese: 向きなおると、香田が眉を吊りあげて俺を睨んでいた。なんだろう。聞いてはいけないことだったのか。
lines.english: When I turned back, Koda was glaring at me, eyebrows raised. What? Had I asked something forbidden?

lines.japanese: 「え、おまえら、またケンカしてんの」
lines.english: “What, are you two fighting again?”

lines.japanese: 「知らん！」
lines.english: “Don't know!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 笑ったり怒ったり忙しい女だ。
lines.english: She was a busy woman, laughing one moment and angry the next.

lines.japanese: まあ、用がなければ愚痴のひとつも聞いてやれたんだけど、あいにく今日は先約がある。
lines.english: If I hadn't already promised someone else, I might've listened to her complain. But somebody was waiting for me.

lines.japanese: 「カリカリしててもいいことねえぞ。じゃあな」
lines.english: “Getting worked up won't do you any good. See you.”

lines.japanese: 「えー待って、どこ行くの？」
lines.english: “Wait, where are you going?”

lines.japanese: 「いいだろ、どこでも。駅の方だよ。ちょっとアレ、ひとと会う約束してんだよ」
lines.english: “Doesn't matter. Toward the station. I've got... plans to meet somebody.”

lines.japanese: 「女か」
lines.english: “A woman?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、男か女かっちゃあ小娘だけど」
lines.english: “Well, if those are the choices, a girl.”

lines.japanese: 「デートか」
lines.english: “A date?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 俺の意外な反応に、やつは二の句を失ったようだ。
lines.english: That answer robbed her of whatever came next.

lines.japanese: じゃ、と言って俺はふたたび夜の柳木原を走りはじめた。
lines.english: “See you.” I set off through Yanagihara at a run again.

lines.japanese: まったく、クソだせえ。
lines.english: Honestly. Fucking pathetic.

lines.japanese: 「なにぃーっ！」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: 背後で叫び声が聞こえた。
lines.english: Her shout rang out behind me.

lines.japanese: アルバトロスの下を駆けぬけ、柳木原一のスクランブル交差点を走って渡る。
lines.english: I raced beneath the Albatross and straight across Yanagihara's busiest pedestrian scramble.

lines.japanese: 今日も柳木原駅前は、往くひと来るひと留まるひとで鬱陶しいぐらい賑わっていた。俺は乱れた息を整えながら、ちゃらちゃらした人体の林を縫って、あの小っこい制服姿を探す。
lines.english: As ever, the plaza outside Yanagihara Station was obnoxiously alive with people coming, going, and going nowhere. I forced my ragged breathing under control and threaded through the forest of gaudily dressed bodies, searching for one small school uniform.

lines.japanese: 円環状の簡易ベンチ──いない。
lines.english: The circular temporary bench—no.

lines.japanese: 東口交番前──いない。
lines.english: Outside the east-exit police box—no.

lines.japanese: 券売機付近──いない。
lines.english: Around the ticket machines—no.

lines.japanese: 地下鉄入り口前──
lines.english: In front of the subway entrance—

lines.japanese: ──いた。
lines.english: —there.

lines.japanese: 植え込みのそばで、コンクリートの陰に潜むみたく小さく突っ立ってる。いや、小さいのは元からか。
lines.english: She stood beside the shrubbery, so small she seemed to be hiding in the concrete's shadow. Though small was her natural state.

lines.japanese: だけど珍しく口を閉じているのは、待ち人の遅刻のせいで不機嫌を募らせてるせいかもしれない。
lines.english: Her mouth was closed for once. Maybe waiting on someone late had darkened her mood by the minute.

lines.japanese: 俺は二度三度その場で肩を上下させ、いくぶん呼吸を落ちつかせてからそちらへ向かっていった。
lines.english: I worked my shoulders up and down two or three times, got my breathing somewhat under control, and went over to her.

lines.japanese: ひとの波を割って現れた俺の姿に気付くと、やつは目を丸くしてぽかんと口を開けた。
lines.english: She spotted me parting the stream of bodies, and her eyes went round. Her mouth fell open.

lines.japanese: そう、睨むでも微笑むでもなく、ぽかーんだ。
lines.english: No glare. No smile. Just openmouthed astonishment.

lines.japanese: 目の前に立つと、鳴のうつろな吐息が聞こえた。
lines.english: When I stopped in front of her, Naru let out a vacant little breath.

lines.japanese: 「え、何そのリアクション」
lines.english: “What kind of reaction is that?”

lines.japanese: 「はあー」
lines.english: “Haaaah.”

lines.japanese: 額の汗を拭う俺を見上げながら、やつは声帯を通した分かりやすい溜息を吐いた。
lines.english: Looking up at me as I wiped the sweat from my forehead, she gave a clear, deliberately audible sigh.

lines.japanese: 「やー、もー、目が合っただけで妊娠するかと思いましたー。この衝撃がいわゆる恋の始まりなんでしょうかー」
lines.english: “Oh wow—I thought I might get pregnant just from making eye contact. Is this shock what people call the beginning of love?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい。遅れてごめんなさい。マジごめんなさい」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Sorry I'm late. Seriously. I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: さんざん聞きなれてるやつのたわ言が今日はなんだか妙にくすぐったくて、俺は話を逸らすように強気の謝罪を繰りかえした。
lines.english: Her usual nonsense, heard a thousand times, felt strangely pleasant and embarrassing today. I doubled down on the apology to steer us away from it.

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうですよ！　ドラさん遅いですよー、何やってたんですか、もー」
lines.english: “Oh, that's right! You *are* late, Dra. What were you doing?”

lines.japanese: ヤブヘビだった。そのまま忘れさせときゃ良かった。
lines.english: I'd walked straight into that one. I should've let her forget.

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、悪かったって言ってんじゃん。謝ってんじゃん。ほら見ろってコレ、日本じゅうの涙と感動を呼ぶぐらい謝ってんだろ」
lines.english: “I know. I said I'm sorry. Look at me—I'm apologizing hard enough to move the entire nation to tears.”

lines.japanese: 「もー、ただでさえ時間ないんですよー？」
lines.english: “Honestly. We hardly had any time to begin with.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうだよな、おまえ終電１２時半だっけ。やべえな、急ごう」
lines.english: “Right. Your last train's at twelve-thirty. Shit, we'd better hurry.”

lines.japanese: 「待ちなさい」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: 目的地のビルへ向けて歩きだそうとしたら、鳴が命令形で俺を呼びとめた。
lines.english: I started toward the building we were headed for. Naru stopped me with a command.

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「遅刻した罰として手を繋ぎなさい」
lines.english: “As punishment for being late, you have to hold my hand.”

lines.japanese: やつは五本の指を広げて水平に差しだした。
lines.english: She spread all five fingers and held her hand out flat.

lines.japanese: 俺たちはしばし向きあったまま動きを止めていた。
lines.english: For a while we stood there facing each other, neither of us moving.

lines.japanese: 「え、なにおまえ。いい歳した男女が、往来でそんな手とかって、恥ずかしくねーの」
lines.english: “What? You... Aren't we a little old to be holding hands in public? Isn't that embarrassing?”

lines.japanese: 「分かりません。未経験なので」
lines.english: “I don't know. I have no experience.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、たぶん恥ずかしいと思うけど」
lines.english: “I'm pretty sure it's embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「でもデートですから、そのぐらい冒険してみても良いのではないでしょうか」
lines.english: “But this is a date. Surely that warrants a little adventure.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかあ？」
lines.english: “You think?”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: ん？　なんだこりゃ。耳の後ろにもっさりとテープが貼ってある。傷の処置にしちゃヘタクソなテーピングだ。いらねえよ、こんなん。俺は無造作に剥がして（痛てっ！）ゴミ箱へ放りなげた。
lines.english: Hm? What was this? A great wad of tape behind my ear. If it was supposed to dress a wound, it was an amateur job. Didn't need it. I tore it off without ceremony—ow!—and tossed it in a trash can.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、でも、遅刻した罰ゲームだからな。罰ゲームじゃ仕方ねえわな。おう、罰ゲームだもんな」
lines.english: “Well, it's punishment for being late. If it's punishment, I guess there's no helping it. Yeah. Punishment.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、もー、男らしくすぱっと覚悟決めてください」
lines.english: “Come on. Be a man and make up your mind already.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ……」
lines.english: “Then...”

lines.japanese: がしっ。
lines.english: I grabbed hold.

lines.japanese: 俺はブレザーの袖から覗く、鳴の細っこい手首を掴んだ。
lines.english: My hand closed around the slender wrist emerging from the sleeve of Naru's blazer.

lines.japanese: 「これでいいの」
lines.english: “This good?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、なんだか補導された万引き少女みたいで、想像してたのとは違う意味で恥ずかしいですね」
lines.english: “Wow. I feel like a shoplifting schoolgirl being marched off by the police. This is embarrassing in a completely different way than I imagined.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そっか。じゃあ……こうか？」
lines.english: “Ah. Right. Then... like this?”

lines.japanese: いったん手首を放し、向かいあったまま右手と右手を重ねてみた。てのひらとてのひら。冷たくて柔らかいその感触を、ぐっと指で包みこんでみる。
lines.english: I let go of her wrist and, still facing her, laid my right hand against hers. Palm to palm. Then I curled my fingers firmly around her cold, soft hand.

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうですよ、これですよ！　うはー、恥ずかしー！」
lines.english: “Yes, that's it! Oh God, this is embarrassing!”

lines.japanese: 鳴は俺に握られた手をぶんぶん上下に振った。
lines.english: Naru pumped our joined hands violently up and down.

lines.japanese: 「いや……つかコレ、握手って言うんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “Wait... isn't this a handshake?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、それもそうですねー。あらー、とたんに恥ずかしくなくなっちゃいましたねー」
lines.english: “Oh. True. How strange—now it isn't embarrassing at all.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは手を重ねて向かいあったまま途方に暮れた。
lines.english: We stayed there facing each other, hands joined, completely at a loss.

lines.japanese: ──なんて、まあ、時間もねえし冗談はこのぐらいでいいか。
lines.english: —Well, we were short on time. Enough fooling around.

lines.japanese: 「だから、要するにこうだろ」
lines.english: “You mean like this.”

lines.japanese: 俺はいったん手を放し、体の向きを変えてからやつの手を握りなおした。
lines.english: I let go, turned to face forward, and took her hand again.

lines.japanese: 「これだ！」
lines.english: “That's it!”

lines.japanese: 「だろ。おら行くぞ」
lines.english: “Thought so. Come on.”

lines.japanese: 思ってたよりずっと小さかったその手を引っぱって、俺は足を踏みだした。やつは予期していなかったのか、歩きしな無様によたついた。
lines.english: I stepped forward, tugging on a hand much smaller than I'd expected. Apparently caught off guard, she stumbled awkwardly into motion.

lines.japanese: 「わたっ！」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「痛てっ、なんだよ、ちゃんと歩けよ」
lines.english: “Ow! Come on, watch your step.”

lines.japanese: 「やーん、しっかり捕まえてないと鳴さんどっか行っちゃうー」
lines.english: “Oh no. Unless you hold on tight, Naru might wander off somewhere.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。時間ねえんだよ。キリキリ歩け」
lines.english: “Shut up. We're short on time. Move.”

lines.japanese: たしかにコレはこっ恥ずかしい。罰ゲームにはぴったりだ。もしこんなところを知ってるやつに見られようものなら、俺はその場で自害さえ辞さないだろう。
lines.english: This really was mortifying. Perfect punishment. If anyone I knew saw me like this, I might have to kill myself on the spot.

lines.japanese: なんとも居たたまれない心持ちで、俺の足は自然いつもより速いペースになった。
lines.english: My skin crawling with embarrassment, I naturally picked up the pace.

lines.japanese: 「わ、わわっ、ぐいぐい引っぱっていく男性すてきー！」
lines.english: “W-whoa! A man who pulls a girl along so boldly is just wonderful!”

lines.japanese: 「うるせーうるせーうるせーうるせー」
lines.english: “Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up.”

lines.japanese: 変な汗とか出てきそうで、俺はやつを引いたまま、何かに追いたてられるような強迫観念のもとずんずん突きすすんだ。
lines.english: A strange sweat began to bead on my skin. Still towing her behind me, I marched ahead as if something were at my heels.

lines.japanese: 「すてきすてき！　ドラさんドラさん、いま作業着だったら私、発情するかもですよー」
lines.english: “Wonderful, wonderful! Dora, if you were wearing work clothes right now, I might go into heat.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ、さかってんじゃねえよ……痛てっ、おまえ手ェ振んな。ぶんぶん降んな。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't get worked up... Ow! Stop swinging my hand. Quit whipping it around or I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「乙女の照れ隠しですよー」
lines.english: “A maiden has to hide her embarrassment somehow.”

lines.japanese: ぶんぶんぶんぶん！
lines.english: Up, down, up, down!

lines.japanese: 俺と鳴との連結部は、歩幅以上のスピードで激しく揺れていた。
lines.english: The coupling between us whipped back and forth faster than our feet were moving.

lines.japanese: さらにやつは五本の指を、それぞれ俺の指のあいだに挿しはさんできた。俗にいう恋人つなぎだ。まったくクソだせえったらありゃしねえ。
lines.english: Then she threaded her fingers through mine—the way lovers hold hands. God, it was fucking pathetic.

lines.japanese: ──そのとき。
lines.english: —Just then.

lines.japanese: 柳木原の雑踏の中、ひとつの影が俺の横を素早く通りすぎ、回りこんで立ちどまった。
lines.english: A shadow shot past me through the Yanagihara crowd, wheeled around, and stopped in our path.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待ったあー！」
lines.english: “Hold it right there!”
“Ugh.”

lines.japanese: 「『げ』とか、ゆーなぁ！」
lines.english: “Don't you ‘ugh’ me!”

lines.japanese: 花水木通りで別れたはずの香田が、なぜかそこに立ちふさがっていた。そりゃ声も出る。俺は無意識のうちに手を放していた。
lines.english: For some reason, Koda—whom I'd left on Flowering Dogwood Street—was blocking our path. No wonder a noise escaped me. Before I knew it, I'd let go of Naru's hand.

lines.japanese: 「なんで！　なんで隼人君がチューリップと一緒にいんの！？」
lines.english: “Why? Why are you with Tulip?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　チューリップ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Tulip?”

lines.japanese: 香田の険しい視線を追って、俺は隣りを向いた。
lines.english: I followed Koda's furious gaze and looked beside me.

lines.japanese: 「香田さん……」
lines.english: “Koda...”

lines.japanese: 鳴は初めてメンマと対面したときみたいな顔をして、一歩後ろに下がっていた。
lines.english: Naru took one step back, wearing the same expression she'd worn when she first came face-to-face with Menma.

lines.japanese: 「え、あれ……なに、おまえら知り合いなの」
lines.english: “Wait... what? You two know each other?”

lines.japanese: 「こっちの台詞だー！」
lines.english: “That's my line!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、同じクラスなんです……」
lines.english: “Um, we're in the same class...”

lines.japanese: 俺の斜め後ろで、鳴がささやくように答えた。
lines.english: Naru answered in a whisper from just behind my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「はっ？　マジで？　え、おまえら同じ学校だったの？」
lines.english: “What? Seriously? You go to the same school?”

lines.japanese: 俺の質問に、ふたりは同時に頷いた。香田は力強く、鳴は弱々しく。
lines.english: They nodded together: Koda emphatically, Naru timidly.

lines.japanese: なんつー偶然だ。いままで香田の制服姿を見たことなんて一度もなかったから、気付く機会がなかった。
lines.english: What a coincidence. I'd never seen Koda in uniform, so I'd never had a chance to notice.

lines.japanese: 「あの、ドラさんはどうして香田さんと……」
lines.english: “Um, Dra, how do you know Koda...?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、どうしてってアレだ。こいつ、よく鳳んとこの連中とツルんでっから。なんとなく。いつの間にか」
lines.english: “How? Well, you know. She hangs around with Kakeru's crew. Somehow. Before I knew it.”

lines.japanese: 「そっちこそなんで？」
lines.english: “Why are *you* with him?”

lines.japanese: 香田が腕を組んで鳴を見据える。やつは物怖じしたみたいに口ごもったので、俺が代わりに答えた。
lines.english: Koda folded her arms and fixed Naru with a stare. Naru faltered, plainly intimidated, so I answered for her.

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、きのう言ったじゃん。いま俺、鳳の妹のチャリ探してるって」
lines.english: “I told you yesterday. I'm looking for Kakeru's little sister's bike.”

lines.japanese: 「オオトリ？　えっ？」
lines.english: “Otori? What?”

lines.japanese: 俯いてしまった鳴の頭を見下ろしながら、香田は呟いた。
lines.english: Looking down at Naru's bowed head, Koda murmured:

lines.japanese: 「え、え……オオトリ、ナル……オオトリ、カケル……」
lines.english: “Wait... Naru Otori... and Kakeru Hououji...”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　じゃあカケルさんの妹って──チューリップ！？」
lines.english: “What!? Then Kakeru's little sister is—Tulip?”

lines.japanese: 甲高い声があがった。俺は後ろを振りかえった。
lines.english: Her voice climbed to a shriek. I looked back over my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「なに。なにチューリップって」
lines.english: “What? What's Tulip?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは……私の仇名です、学校での……」
lines.english: “Ha ha... my nickname. At school...”

lines.japanese: 鳴は顔をあげてヘタクソな笑顔を作った。俺はそれを見て……えーと、ベロの先でほっぺたを膨らませた。いや、なんとなく。
lines.english: Naru looked up and made a poor imitation of a smile. I saw it and... well, pushed my tongue into one cheek. No reason.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……うそぉ！　自転車なくした団地妻もチューリップ！？」
lines.english: “Wait... no way! The apartment wife who lost her bike was Tulip too?”

lines.japanese: 「だから、団地妻なんてひと言も言ってねーっつの」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, I never said a word about any apartment wife.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　あっ！　ええっ！　じゃあデートの相手チューリップ！？」
lines.english: “What? Oh! What!? Then Tulip's your date?”

lines.japanese: 香田の甲高い声は耳に響く。俺は顔をしかめて後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: Koda's shrill voice drilled into my ears. I grimaced and raked at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「おまえさあ、ちょっとアレだよ。ぶっちゃけうるせえよ」
lines.english: “Listen. Here's the thing. You're loud.”

lines.japanese: 「なにが！」
lines.english: “What's loud?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、チューリップだかシューマッハだか知んねーけど、ソレ紛らわしいんだよ。こいつは鳴だろ。鳴で統一しろ」
lines.english: “Tulip, Schumacher, whatever—it's confusing. Her name's Naru. Just call her Naru.”

lines.japanese: 「え、鳴？　鳴さん？　鳴ちゃん？」
lines.english: “Naru? Miss Naru? Or... just Naru?”

lines.japanese: 香田は俺の提唱した呼称を口にしながら、首を傾けて同級生の顔を覗きこんだ。
lines.english: Ai tried the possibilities aloud, tilting her head as she peered into her classmate’s face.

lines.japanese: 「ねー、隼人君そう言ってるけど、鳴ちゃんでいいの？」
lines.english: “Hayato says just Naru. Is that okay with you?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “Y-yeah.”

lines.japanese: 鳴は同級生の目を窺いながらぎこちなく頷いた。そう言えば、こいつの口から敬語じゃない言葉を聞くのは初めてかもしれない。
lines.english: Naru nodded awkwardly, watching her classmate's eyes. Come to think of it, this might have been the first time I'd heard her speak without polite language.

lines.japanese: 「私はぜんぜん……香田さんさえ良ければ」
lines.english: “I don’t mind... if you’re all right with it, Miss Koda.”

lines.japanese: 「え、待ってよ、じゃあ私も亜衣で統一してよ」
lines.english: “Hold on, then you've got to call me Ai.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、亜衣ちゃん？」
lines.english: “A-Ai?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 香田はにんまり笑ってから、俺に向きなおった。
lines.english: Koda grinned broadly, then turned to me.

lines.japanese: 「はい、そっちのおにいさんも」
lines.english: “All right, you too, mister.”

lines.japanese: 俺もかよ。
lines.english: Me too?

lines.japanese: 「あー……亜衣？」
lines.english: “Uh... Ai?”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、よーし」
lines.english: “Heh heh. Good.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、君も隼人で統一だ」
lines.english: “Then you're Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「えーと、隼人さん？」
lines.english: “Um... Hayato... sir?”

lines.japanese: 「うおぉっ……」
ムズ痒い。思わず体が強張った。
lines.english: The feeling prickled under my skin. My whole body stiffened on its own.

lines.japanese: ……ま、そのうち慣れるか。
lines.english: ...Well. I'd get used to it eventually.

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん。隼人さん？　隼人さん……」
lines.english: “Hayato, sir. Hayato, sir? Hayato, sir...”

lines.japanese: やつはにやけながら小さく繰りかえした。うおぉ。
lines.english: She repeated it softly, grinning. Ghh.

lines.japanese: 「えー、『さん』だって」
lines.english: “Seriously? ‘Sir’?”

lines.japanese: 香田──じゃねえや、亜衣が挑戦的に笑った。鳴が抗議する。
lines.english: Koda—no, Ai—smiled challengingly. Naru protested.

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんでー？　なんでおかしいのー？」
lines.english: “What? Why? What's funny about it?”

lines.japanese: 「鳴ちゃん、よそよそしー。ねー、隼人君」
lines.english: “Naru, you’re so formal. Right, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は俺の左腕を掴んだ。なだらかな硬い感触。鳴が下唇を噛んだ。
lines.english: Ai caught my left arm. A smooth, firm sensation. Naru bit her lower lip.

lines.japanese: 「亜衣ちゃん、なれなれしー。ねー、隼人さん」
lines.english: “Ai, you’re getting awfully familiar. Aren’t you, Hayato, sir?”

lines.japanese: 鳴は俺の右腕を掴んだ。底の浅い柔らかな感触。亜衣が眉間に皺を寄せた。
lines.english: Naru caught my right arm. A shallow, soft sensation. Ai furrowed her brow.

lines.japanese: 「いいの！　私は本妻だからいいの！　鳴ちゃん愛人なんだから、隼人君から離れてよ！」
lines.english: “It's fine! I'm the official wife, so it's fine! Naru, you're only his mistress. Get away from Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「でもー、私いまからデートだよー？」
lines.english: “But I'm about to go on a date with him.”

lines.japanese: 「なにぃーっ！」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: 「しかも二度目だよー」
lines.english: “And it's our second.”

lines.japanese: 敬語じゃなくても伸びるのか語尾。
lines.english: Even without polite speech, she still stretched the ends of her sentences.

lines.japanese: いや、それどころじゃない。小娘二匹が俺の両腕にしがみついて引っぱりあってる。俺の体はふらふらと左右に揺れた。
lines.english: But that was beside the point. Two little girls clung to my arms and pulled in opposite directions. My body swayed helplessly from side to side.

lines.japanese: 「おい。おい待てガキ共。なんだコレ。奉行の前で子を奪いあう母たちか。痛い痛い、地味に痛い。もげるもげる、もげるって腕」
lines.english: “Hey. Wait, you brats. What is this, the Judgment of Solomon? Ow, ow, that actually hurts. My arms are coming off. I mean it.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと！　隼人君ソレどーゆーこと！」
lines.english: “Wait! Hayato, what is going on?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なにが」
lines.english: “Huh? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ふたりはデキてるですか！」
lines.english: “Are you two together?”

lines.japanese: 「ハァ！？　おま、なにアホなこと──」
lines.english: “What!? Don’t be stupid—”

lines.japanese: 「できてるよー」
lines.english: “We are.”

lines.japanese: 「うそだ！　ありえない！」
lines.english: “Liar! Impossible!”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとだよー、妊娠５分だよー」
lines.english: “It's true. I'm five minutes pregnant.”

lines.japanese: 「認知しない！　隼人君、不能だもん！」
lines.english: “I refuse to acknowledge the child! Hayato is impotent!”

lines.japanese: 「やー、ところが彼、制服姿の小さい子には目がなくってー」
lines.english: “Ah, but he loses all judgment around little girls in school uniforms.”

lines.japanese: 「しまった、盲点だ！」
lines.english: “Damn, I overlooked that!”

lines.japanese: アホらしくて反論する気にもなんねぇ。
lines.english: It was too idiotic to deserve an answer.

lines.japanese: 脱力した俺の体を、小娘共は目的地に着くまで引っぱりあっていた。
lines.english: The two little girls continued tugging my limp body in opposite directions until we reached our destination.

lines.japanese: それでも強引に腕を振りほどいて逃げたりしなかったのは、引きこもりのクラスメイト同士が、なんだかんだ言いつつ俺を介してパワーバランスを整えてるように見えたからだ。
lines.english: I still didn't shake them off and flee. For all their bickering, it looked as though two shut-in classmates were using me to establish a balance of power between them.

lines.japanese: いや、言っとくけど、べつに感触を楽しんでたとか、そういうことじゃねえからな。
lines.english: And just to be clear, it wasn't because I was enjoying the sensations or anything like that.

lines.japanese: いや、マジで。
lines.english: Seriously.

lines.japanese: うん、ごめん、ちょっと楽しかった。
lines.english: All right, sorry. I enjoyed it a little.
